pages.raw_title: North America's Leading Metal Coatings Company - About AZZ
pages.raw_meta: Learn about AZZ, North America's leading metal coatings company, delivering galvanizing, coil coating, and advanced metal coating solutions since 1956.
raw_blocks: Industry-leading provider of metal coating solutions supporting everyday life

AZZ Inc. is North America’s leading independent provider of hot-dip galvanizing and coil coating solutions serving a broad range of end markets. Collectively, our business segments provide sustainable, unmatched metal coating solutions that enhance the longevity and appearance of the buildings, products and infrastructure people rely on every day.
Meeting the needs of diverse and evolving markets

AZZ combines large-scale galvanizing operations, integrated coil coating capabilities, and advanced surface technologies to help customers improve corrosion protection, operational efficiency, product quality, and long-term performance. Backed by an extensive network of facilities and specialized coating technologies, AZZ helps customers access the solutions, capacity, and technical support needed to meet changing business demands.
North America’s largest hot-dip galvanizer of fabricated steel

AZZ Galvanizing provides industry-leading corrosion protection solutions that help extend service life, reduce maintenance requirements, and improve lifecycle performance across critical infrastructure and fabricated steel applications. As North America’s largest hot-dip galvanizer , AZZ combines scalable capacity, decades of galvanizing expertise, and a commitment to consistent quality and responsive customer support.
North America’s leading independent provider of coil coating services

AZZ Precoat Metals delivers coil coating and value-added processing solutions engineered to increase production efficiency, product durability, and appearance performance across thousands of applications. Strategically located facilities and integrated processing capabilities help customers improve supply chain efficiency, simplify production coordination, and respond to changing manufacturing demands.
Advanced surface technologies and metal finishing solutions

AZZ Surface Technologies provides advanced metal finishing systems and value-added coating services tailored to environmental, performance, and industry requirements. Through automated operations, integrated coating systems, and extensive finishing expertise, AZZ simplifies coating coordination, reduces supply chain complexity, and meets accelerated project schedules through a single experienced finishing partner.
Built on expertise. Focused on the future.

AZZ continues to invest in advanced manufacturing technologies, sustainability initiatives , operational efficiency, and workforce development that support responsible growth across its businesses. Through its commitment to governance, environmental responsibility, and social impact, AZZ strives to create long-term value for customers, employees, shareholders, and the communities it serves.
